name: Verify and test barrier removal in public PyTorch WeightNorm
description: Unmodified public compiler-generated PyTorch WeightNorm forward first-dimension PTX as baseline. Exact upstream input bytes: 2 CTAs of 256 threads, rowSize=1024, dynamic shared memory=1024 bytes per CTA, distinct w/norms/v/g allocations, bf16 w/v/g and float32 norms. Preserve upstream optional assumptions duplicate_tma_store_benign, representative_election and clc_always_fails enabled; other optional assumptions retain pinned defaults (false). No branch decisions or input changes. Try at most three standalone CTA-barrier deletions through the existing verifier loop. Synchronization-only check; no reference execution, model inference, hardware execution or performance measurement.
